SELECT MIN(id) as id, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT asin, ',') as asin, spu, sid, mid, MIN(seller_name) as seller_name, MIN(country) as country, MIN(currency_code) as currency_code, MIN(currency_icon) as currency_icon, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT item_name, ' | ') as item_name, MIN(small_image_url) as small_image_url, MIN(amazon_url) as amazon_url, MIN(price) as price, MIN(status) as status,
-- 销售相关数据汇总 SUM(volume) as volume, SUM(order_items) as order_items, SUM(amount) as amount, SUM(net_amount) as net_amount, AVG(avg_custom_price) as avg_custom_price, SUM(avg_volume) as avg_volume,

-- 促销数据汇总 SUM(promotion_volume) as promotion_volume, SUM(promotion_amount) as promotion_amount, SUM(promotion_order_items) as promotion_order_items, SUM(promotion_discount) as promotion_discount,
-- 利润数据汇总 SUM(gross_profit) as gross_profit, SUM(predict_gross_profit) as predict_gross_profit, AVG(gross_margin) as gross_margin, AVG(predict_gross_margin) as predict_gross_margin, AVG(roi) as roi,
-- 评论数据取平均 AVG(reviews_count) as reviews_count, AVG(avg_star) as avg_star, AVG(prev_star) as prev_star, AVG(comment_rate) as comment_rate,
-- 退货数据汇总 SUM(return_count) as return_count, AVG(return_rate) as return_rate, SUM(return_goods_count) as return_goods_count, AVG(return_goods_rate) as return_goods_rate, SUM(return_amount) as return_amount,
-- 库存数据汇总 SUM(afn_fulfillable_quantity) as afn_fulfillable_quantity, SUM(afn_inbound_receiving_quantity) as afn_inbound_receiving_quantity, SUM(afn_inbound_shipped_quantity) as afn_inbound_shipped_quantity, SUM(afn_inbound_working_quantity) as afn_inbound_working_quantity, SUM(afn_unsellable_quantity) as afn_unsellable_quantity, SUM(reserved_fc_processing) as reserved_fc_processing, SUM(reserved_fc_transfers) as reserved_fc_transfers, SUM(fbm_quantity) as fbm_quantity, SUM(reserved_customerorders) as reserved_customerorders, SUM(stock_up_num) as stock_up_num,
AVG(available_days) as available_days, AVG(fbm_available_days) as fbm_available_days, AVG(month_stock_sales_ratio) as month_stock_sales_ratio, AVG(inventory_sales_ratio) as inventory_sales_ratio,
-- 流量数据汇总 SUM(clicks) as clicks, SUM(sessions) as sessions, SUM(sessions_mobile) as sessions_mobile, SUM(sessions_total) as sessions_total, SUM(page_views) as page_views, SUM(page_views_mobile) as page_views_mobile, SUM(page_views_total) as page_views_total, AVG(buy_box_percentage) as buy_box_percentage,
-- 转化率取平均 AVG(cvr) as cvr, AVG(ctr) as ctr, AVG(volume_cvr) as volume_cvr, AVG(ad_cvr) as ad_cvr,
-- 广告数据汇总 SUM(impressions) as impressions, SUM(ad_clicks) as ad_clicks, SUM(ad_order_quantity) as ad_order_quantity, SUM(ad_sales_amount) as ad_sales_amount, SUM(spend) as spend,
AVG(cpc) as cpc, AVG(cpm) as cpm, AVG(cpo) as cpo, AVG(acos) as acos, AVG(acoas) as acoas, AVG(roas) as roas, AVG(asoas) as asoas, AVG(adv_rate) as adv_rate, AVG(tacos) as tacos,
SUM(ads_sp_cost) as ads_sp_cost, SUM(ads_sp_sales) as ads_sp_sales, SUM(ads_sd_cost) as ads_sd_cost, SUM(ads_sd_sales) as ads_sd_sales, SUM(shared_ads_sb_cost) as shared_ads_sb_cost, SUM(shared_ads_sb_sales) as shared_ads_sb_sales, SUM(shared_ads_sbv_cost) as shared_ads_sbv_cost, SUM(shared_ads_sbv_sales) as shared_ads_sbv_sales, SUM(shared_cost_of_advertising) as shared_cost_of_advertising, SUM(ad_direct_sales_amount) as ad_direct_sales_amount, SUM(ad_direct_order_quantity) as ad_direct_order_quantity,
-- 排名数据取最小值（最好的排名） MIN(cate_rank) as cate_rank, MIN(prev_cate_rank) as prev_cate_rank, MIN(rank_category) as rank_category, MIN(small_cate_rank) as small_cate_rank, MIN(prev_small_cate_rank) as prev_small_cate_rank, MIN(small_rank_category) as small_rank_category,
-- 库龄数据汇总 SUM(inventory_age_0_90) as inventory_age_0_90, SUM(inventory_age_91_180) as inventory_age_91_180, SUM(inventory_age_180_plus) as inventory_age_180_plus, SUM(inv_age_181_to_270_days) as inv_age_181_to_270_days, SUM(inv_age_271_to_365_days) as inv_age_271_to_365_days, SUM(inv_age_365_plus_days) as inv_age_365_plus_days,

MIN(creator) as creator, MIN(create_time) as create_time, MAX(updater) as updater, MAX(update_time) as update_time, 0 as deleted, MIN(tenant_id) as tenant_id FROM amazon_product_performance WHERE deleted = 0
